mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(account.current_balance) FROM connected_account account INNER JOIN codef_connection connection ON connection.connection_id = account.connection_id WHERE connection.user_id = #{userId} AND connection.status = 'ACTIVE' AND account.status = 'ACTIVE' ), 0) AS base_asset, goal.target_amount, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(history.amount) FROM transaction_history history INNER JOIN connected_account account ON account.account_id = history.account_id INNER JOIN codef_connection connection ON connection.connection_id = account.connection_id WHERE connection.user_id = #{userId} AND history.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAW' AND (history.category IS NULL OR history.category != 'ASSET') AND history.transaction_datetime >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ), 0) AS monthly_spending_average, profile.soldier_type, profile.enlistment_date, profile.discharge_date, active_strategy.application_id AS active_strategy_application_id, active_strategy.applied_monthly_spending_amount, active_strategy.applied_monthly_saving_amount, active_strategy.applied_monthly_investment_amount, active_strategy.applied_expected_return_rate FROM soldier_profile profile INNER JOIN goal ON goal.user_id = profile.user_id AND goal.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN strategy_application active_strategy ON active_strategy.application_id = ( SELECT candidate.application_id FROM strategy_application candidate WHERE candidate.user_id = profile.user_id AND candidate.source_type = 'AI_RECOMMENDATION' AND candidate.analysis_id IS NOT NULL AND candidate.applied_monthly_spending_amount IS NOT NULL AND candidate.applied_monthly_saving_amount IS NOT NULL AND candidate.applied_monthly_investment_amount IS NOT NULL AND candidate.applied_expected_return_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY candidate.applied_at DESC, candidate.application_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE profile.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT account.current_balance, saving.monthly_amount, saving.interest_rate, saving.government_support_expected, saving.end_date FROM soldier_saving saving INNER JOIN connected_account account ON account.account_id = saving.account_id INNER JOIN codef_connection connection ON connection.connection_id = account.connection_id WHERE saving.user_id = #{userId} AND connection.status = 'ACTIVE' AND account.status = 'ACTIVE' AND saving.monthly_amount IS NOT NULL AND saving.interest_rate IS NOT NULL AND saving.end_date IS NOT NULL

mapper.select: SELECT forecast_id, user_id, base_asset, expected_salary, expected_saving_amount, expected_asset, monthly_spending_limit, achievement_rate, financial_discharge_date, policy_version, generated_at FROM cashflow_forecast WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY generated_at DESC, forecast_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT forecast_month_id, forecast_id, forecast_month, expected_rank, expected_salary, expected_saving_amount, expected_investment_amount, expected_spending_amount, expected_ending_asset FROM cashflow_forecast_month WHERE forecast_id = #{forecastId} ORDER BY forecast_month ASC
